there is a significant correlation between basic research and output of university in China.
there are stronger correlations between basic research input (BR) and output (BO) of universities in China, but lesser correlations between growth rate of BR and BO.
the correlation between basic research output and its input in universities is stronger than the correlation between growth rate in the two variables.

the quantitative analysis of correlation between basic research and its output, and it can provide a new way of thinking for the research on the relationship between input and output of basic research.
the quantitative analysis of basic research input-output correlation in Chinese universities.
the quantitative study of the correlation between basic research and its output of university in China, which is of great significance for promoting the basic research of university.

there exists correlation between basic research and output of universities, but the correlation is not so significant.

the correlation of basic research input-output is stronger than that of the growth rate of basic input-output in universities in China.
the research input and output are the most important factors for the university research performance.
